subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent task completion close only run-owned temporary browser tabs, and which user actions should preserve a tab?
rationale: Current code intentionally keeps active primary-session tabs reusable, while the requested default changes browser/session state at task completion and can close user-visible pages if ownership semantics are wrong.

options.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
options.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

options.title: Keep idle/cap behavior only
options.body: Treat current reusable primary tabs plus idle/cap cleanup as the intended behavior and close or reject the stronger task-end default.

options.title: Opt-in strict cleanup mode
options.body: Preserve current behavior by default and add a documented opt-in mode for stricter task-end cleanup.

recommendation.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
recommendation.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits on the browser cleanup helper, session lifecycle, and plugin/runtime ownership boundaries where steipete has the strongest history.
